verdict.rationale: PostHog's own product-analytics docs say you can build insights, save them to dashboards, and share them. Dashboards are also a first-class object, with a dedicated 18-tool MCP category and PostHog AI that creates dashboards. The evidence is short, marketing-level statements rather than in-depth docs. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of team sharing mechanics (permissions, share links, collaboration), dashboard layout/composition detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team

citations.quote: Build trends, funnels, retention, paths, stickiness, and lifecycle insights on the events you already send to PostHog, then save them to dashboards, share them, and get alerted when they move.
Build insights, assemble dashboards, share them, and set alerts on the numbers that matter.
PostHog AI creates dashboards, surveys, alerts, and feature flags
